lead: Test build 0.8.26a (CI run 39147901750). New in this round, all from the analysis of the Virus' own firmware: (1) Active Sensing is sent every 300 ms like the original, instead of once per start (the Virus releases every sounding voice about a second after the last one it received, E237); (2) all time-stamped MIDI to the Virus is kept under a byte budget so a flood cannot overrun the Virus' 2046-byte stamp queue (E238); (3) the broker retries a USB write the busy Virus did not take within a second, instead of dropping the rest of the message (E239, libusb and WinUSB); (4) on Linux, popup menus open on the monitor they belong to (E227, first test with the CI build). This round changes USB and timing code, so the core items run on every system. The real PC is last and optional: skip it if you like. Mark each item, add a note where something looks different, then copy the results at the bottom into the chat. When all pass, 0.8.26 is released.
rules: Item 2 on each system (bank sync) only changes patches in the Virus' edit buffer from its panel: never store a patch on the Virus.
Order: Linux first (the Virus is on this PC), then the Windows 11 VM, then macOS, then the real PC if you want it. Close the DAW before the Virus moves.

sections.title: Linux
sections.where: REAPER via pw-jack, Virus on this PC
prep: Claude installs 0.8.26a (replaces the dev build in ~/.vst3 and the broker; you may be asked for sudo for the udev rule). Logging is on. Restart REAPER if it was open.
In the test project add a second track with one long chord (4 whole notes, bars 1-4) on part 1, a pad or any patch with a long release.
notes: Exports in REAPER: File > Render, Source Master mix, Render speed Full-speed offline.

items.title: Long notes are not cut (Active Sensing)
steps: Optional, in a terminal: ~/virus-ti-re/build-native/bin/Release/virusmon 600 --clock shows an Active Sensing line about every 0.3 s.
Close and reopen the project. As soon as the start-up page is gone, play the chord track from bar 1.
Stop in bar 2, press Play again; then set a loop over bars 1-2 and let it run three times.
items.expect: the chord holds the full length every time, no note drops out about a second after start or after Play.

items.title: Bank sync while the Virus is busy (USB write retry)
steps: REAPER closed. Rename the bank cache: mv ~/.local/share/virus-ti-native/cache ~/.local/share/virus-ti-native/cache.old.
Open the project: the plug-in starts reading RAM A-D (progress bar). Do not play.
During the first two minutes change the patch on the Virus' panel about five times (patch up/down; never store).
Let the sync finish (about 8 minutes). Then open LOAD > RAM A on part 1.
items.expect: the sync finishes without an error page, RAM A-D list their patch names. Claude reads the broker log afterwards (lines with "timeout(s)").

items.title: Popup menus on the right monitor
steps: Move the plug-in window to the smaller monitor, close to its right or bottom edge.
Click LOAD on part 1 and open a submenu, then a long value list (filter mode).
items.expect: menus and submenus stay on that monitor, a submenu flips to the left at the monitor's border, nothing opens where there are no pixels.
